body.name: paired-versus-mixed precision collections
body.construction: For each \(n\), set \(K=4\), \(n_s=n\), \(\mathcal X=\{x_1,x_2\}\), \(p_T(x_1)=p_T(x_2)=1/2\), \(p_s(x)=1\) on the unique supported cell, and \(e_s(x)=1/2\). In every source draw \(C_s\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(\mu_n)\) and an independent Rademacher \(\varepsilon_s\); set \(D_s(0)=0\), \(D_s(1)=C_s\), and \(Y_s(z,d)=1/2+\varepsilon_s\sqrt{q_s}/2\). Set \(D_T(0)=0\), draw \(D_T(1)\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(\mu_n)\) independently within each target cell, and set \(Y_T(z,d)=1/2\). In \(P_n^A\), sources \(1,2\) cover \(x_1\) with \(q_s=q_L\), while sources \(3,4\) cover \(x_2\) with \(q_s=q_H\). In \(P_n^B\), sources \(1,3\) cover \(x_1\) and sources \(2,4\) cover \(x_2\), with \(q_1=q_2=q_L\) and \(q_3=q_4=q_H\).
